cards.title: Ikea Visit Reveals Your Parenting Wisdom Gaps
cards.body: A mother discovers how little domestic knowledge she's imparted to her son during a pre-university shopping trip to Ikea. The experience becomes a humbling moment of self-reflection about parenting and life skills.

cards.title: Kids' Quiz: Test Your Knowledge With Junior Questions
cards.body: Five multiple-choice questions set by children challenge adults on fascinating topics like octopus blood color and sky weight. You can also submit your own junior brainteasers for future quizzes.

cards.title: Suburban Life Changes When You Find the Right Community
cards.body: A family's move to Melbourne's suburbs initially felt boring until they discovered excitement in unexpected places. The experience shows how perspective and community connections transform a parent's view of family life.

cards.title: Parent Guilt: Finding Agency Without Blame
cards.body: Parents struggle with guilt, but a family systems approach offers a path from blame to agency and hope. Understanding your role can help you support your children more effectively.

cards.title: Neurodivergent Kids Need Support, Not Over-Accommodation
cards.body: The key question isn't whether your child has a diagnosis, but what they can handle right now. Confusing these two can lead parents to over-accommodate and limit children's growth.

cards.title: Adult Children Supporting Parents Through Divorce
cards.body: When parents divorce, adult children's roles in the family shift dramatically. You can support them without becoming their therapist, mediator, or emotional safety net.
